2707-4377-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
2707-4377-8267.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1322-2023-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-4314--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-4314--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

240-4247-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

6495-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
6495-7804--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
6495-7804--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4247-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-6097.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-7399.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1170-1477-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
392-1170-1477-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

2438-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
2438-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

2921-3317-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2921-3317-5972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6835-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6073-6972-7136.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Aquastrand Spider.
6073-6972-7136.description:
Kill Aquastrand Spider.
When Aquastrand Spider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Aquastrand Spider enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Aquastrand Spider triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Aquastrand Spider dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

1116-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1594-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
1594-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1350-3480-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-3480-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-2921-5058.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

224-654-1772-5621.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Arid Archway
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

3384-4067-4435-6480.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
3384-4067-4435-6480.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

1283-2034-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Repeat.

1453-1657.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-4558-4863-5231.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-4558-4863-5231.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1621-3306-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
1621-3306-4605.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

618-1734-2438.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2792-3525-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
2792-3525-5921-5970-6120.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1350-3129-5287.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1350-3129-5287.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}{W}{B}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant

678-891-2034-4089-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Glasspool Mimic.
678-891-2034-4089-5214.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding {C}{C}.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, Enduring Renewal and Next of Kin trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Next of Kin trigger, putting Glasspool Mimic from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Glasspool Mimic.
Repeat.

1778-3156-3661-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Memnite, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Memnite.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Memnite.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1987-2556-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-2556-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Great Whale.
When Mnemonic Wall and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

565-2792-2871.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
565-2792-2871.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting Great Whale.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving the nontoken Great Whale +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

1043-1371-5141.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Teferi's Protection.
Resolve all Teferi's Protections, causing all players to phase out all permanents they control.
During your next untap step, Disciple of Caelus Nin and all other phased out permanents you control phase in.
Disciple of Caelus Nin prevents all permanents your opponents own that are phased out from phasing in, causing them to stay phased out indefinitely.

322-2657-2757-3000.notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
322-2657-2757-3000.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a basic land card, creating a 2/2 Bear and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squirrel or the Bear, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-1604-2011.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Najeela and Ith.
339-1604-2011.description:
Declare Najeela, Jegantha and Ith as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Ith by tapping it, untapping Jegantha and preventing all damage done to and done by Jegantha this turn.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that can't be spent on generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

11-1283-1467-1987.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell with Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
11-1283-1467-1987.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {3}, targeting any two permanents.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting Jin-Gitaxias and Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {2}, targeting Ghostly Flicker.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Ghostly Flicker, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Ghostly Flicker targeting Jin-Gitaxias and Chromatic Orrery, and returning the original Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Jin-Gitaxias and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.

11-1980-2196.notablePrerequisites: You control three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
11-1980-2196.description:
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Frantic Search.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Frantic Search and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning it to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

328-2292-3211-3260-4078-4812.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 18.
Your devotion to black is at least ten or you have at least two opponents.
328-2292-3211-3260-4078-4812.description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1} and two life.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Chainer onto the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 5.
